title: NSA may have tracked Sherman since childhood

tellings.quote: >> Sherman believes the NSA may even have tracked him since childhood [music] into his young adulthood and military service

plain: A former sergeant named Dan Sherman, who says the NSA hired him to communicate with aliens, believes the agency may have tracked him from childhood through his young adulthood and military service. Michels relays this as Sherman's own belief in an episode built around Sherman's account. If true, it would mean Sherman was picked out for the work long before he knew it.
